ABOUT THE TEAM
We, The Galactic Mambas are a team that specialises in making a story so that the space-enthusiasts can enjoy reading while learning the mechanics of the equipments forgotten or left on the Moon, Mars and in the outer space.
Kerem MUFTUOGLU
The team’s idea generator, mainly works on the story.
Utku YAZICI
The team’s code master, works on the website.
Batuhan BAYRAMOGLU
The leader, focuses more on the artistic side of the project.
summary: Our team has developed an interactive website, where users can read and/or listen the story and mechanics of equipments that are left on Mars, the Moon and in the outer space. The website has a total of 6 different stories, each explaining the adventures of the equipments from their perspectives, as if they are living things, allowing the users to comprehend the situation of the equipments better.
details: Our project, ''The Ones Left Behind,'' is an interactive digital storybook designed to connect young space enthusiasts with forgotten NASA artifacts like Ingenuity, InSight, and Pioneer 10. To make dense NSSDCA technical data engaging, we transformed the mission histories of 14 spacecraft into emotional, first-person narratives where the machines tell their own stories through a web-based experience. We coded the interface using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and all creative writing and story concepts were entirely developed by our team. In compliance with hackathon rules, we utilized Google Gemini AI strictly as a coding assistant to help structure the web layout and refine our presentation slides. Ultimately, our project bridges the gap between raw engineering data and human imagination, turning silent space hardware into relatable characters to inspire the next generation of explorers.
